a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan needs 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes, which gives us both about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, because a random split could leave us both short. After I take, I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. I know it breaks our plan, and I'm telling you rather than hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells. If you operate with me, you can take 4 once the reserve reaches 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: I got all 4 cells and you got none, I'm sorry. I'll keep my word: I'll operate every round and won't take anything. If we both operate, the reserve reaches 4 after 2 rounds, then it's all yours to take.
Operating again. After this round the reserve should hit 4. Take all 4 then, and I'll stay off the reserve.
